senses.gloss: क्रियमाण mfn. (pr. Pass. p.) being done &c.

क्रि॑मि for कृ॑मि, q.v.
क्रिम्ण mfn. (= कृमिण) having worms, ĀpŚr. ix, 20, 2.
क्रिय m. (borrowed fr. Gk.κριός.) the sign Aries, VarBṛ. i, iii, x, xvii; Gaṇit.; Horāś.
क्रिया f. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 100), doing, performing, performance, occupation with (in comp.), business, act, action, undertaking, activity, work, labour, KātyŚr.; Mn.; Yājñ. &c.
bodily action, exercise of the limbs, L.

(in Gr.) action (as the general idea expressed by any verb), verb, Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 3, 1 &c. (according to later grammarians a verb is of two kinds, सकर्म-क्रिया, ‘active’, and अकर्म-क्˚, ‘intransitive’)
a noun of action, W.
a literary work, Vikr.
medical treatment or practice, applying a remedy, cure (see सम-क्रिय-त्व and विषम-क्˚), Suśr.
a religious rite or ceremony, sacrificial act, sacrifice, Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
with चरमा, ‘the last ceremony’, rites performed immediately after death, obsequies, purificatory rites (as ablution &c.), MBh. iv, 834; R. vi, 96, 10
religious action, worship, BhP. vii, 14, 39; RāmatUp.
Religious Action (personified as a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Dharma, MBh. i, 2578; Hariv. 12452; BhP.; or as a daughter of Kardama and wife of Kratu, BhP.)
judicial investigation (by human means, as by witnesses, documents, &c., or by superhuman means, as by various ordeals) Comm. on Yājñ.
atonement, L.
disquisition, L.
study, L.
means, expedient, L.
क्रियमाणक n. a literary essay, VarBṛS. i, 5.

a student, W.
क्रिया—कार m. a beginner, novice, L.
an agreement, Kāraṇḍ. xvii
an arrangement, rule, Divyāv.
क्रिया—कर्तृ m. a doer of an action, agent, W.
क्रिया—कलाप m. N. of wk.

क्रिया-द्वैत n. efficient cause (as resigning all to God), W.

N. of wk.
क्रिया-योग—सार m. a section of the PadmaP.
क्रिया-रत्न-समुच्चय m. N. of wk.,
क्रियारोह m. = चक्र-वात, L.
क्रियार्थ m. an action as object, Jaim. i, 1, 25
क्रियार्थ mf(आ)n. having an action (i.e. another action) as its aim, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 14

क्रिया-लाघव n. ease in the functions (of an organ), Bhpr.

क्रिया-वादिन् m. one who states the arguments in a law-suit Comm. on Yājñ.

क्रिया-विधि m. a rule of action, Mn. ix, 220; xii, 87

क्रियेन्द्रिय n. = कर्मेन्द्˚ (q.v.), L.
क्रि॑वि m. a N. of Rudra (v.l. क्र॑यिन्, q.v.)
a leather bag (metaphorically ‘a cloud’), RV.
a well, Naigh. iii, 23
N. of an Asura, Sāy.
sg. and pl. (इस्, अयस्) the original N. of the Pañcālas, ŚBr. xiii, 5, 4, 7

क्रीत॑ mfn. bought, purchased, ŚBr.; Mn. &c.

won by (instr.), Śak. iii (v.l.)
ifc. (with the purchase-price; f(ई). ), Pāṇ. iv, 1, 50; vi, 2, 151

क्रीड् cl. 1. P. क्री॑डति (or क्री॑ळति, RV.; ep. also Ā.; perf. चिक्रीड, MBh.; fut. p. क्रीडिष्यत्, BhP. iii, 17, 24 ; aor. अक्रीडीत्, Bhaṭṭ.),
to play, sport, amuse one's self, frolic, gambol, dally (used of men, animals, the wind and waves, &c.), RV.; VS.; AV. &c.;
to jest, joke with (instr. or instr. with सह or सार्धम्; once acc. Mṛcch.), Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.:
Caus. क्रीडयति, to cause to play, allow to play, MBh. i, 6440; iv, 329; BhP.
क्रीड॑ mfn. playing, sporting (said of the winds), RV. i, 37, 1 and 5; 166, 2
क्रीड॑ (अस्), m. sport, play, L.

क्रीडा॑ (आ॑), f. sport, play, pastime, amusement, amorous sport (often in comp., e.g. क्रीडा-मुदः f. pl. the pleasures of playing or of amorous sport, Gīt. ix, 9; कृष्ण-क्˚, sport with Kṛṣṇa, BhP. ii, 3, 15; जल-क्˚, playing about in water, MBh.; Pañcat.; BhP.; तोय-क्˚ id., Megh.), VS. xviii, 5; R.; Suśr. &c.
working miracles for one's amusement, Lalit.
disrespect shown by jest or joke, L.
a play-ground, MBh. iii, 12318
(in music) a kind of measure.

क्रीडनीय n. a plaything, toy, MBh. xiii, 4206; Kād.
क्रीडनीयक m. id., Kathās. li, lxxi.
क्रीडनीयक—संनिभ mfn. like a toy or doll, Kathās. xii, 74.
